newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Benpres says Jan-Mar net at 461 mln pesos.
newsitem.headline: Benpres says Jan-Mar net at 461 mln pesos.

text.p: Benpres Holdings Corp said on Friday it posted a 13.56 percent growth in first quarter net income to 461 million pesos from 406 million a year earlier.
Revenue hit 560 million pesos from 427 million last year.
Net earnings of affiliates rose to 469 million pesos from 427 million.

Benpres chief operating officer J. Xavier Gonzales said the growth was achieved even though contributions from its media unit ABS-CBN Broadcasting Corp declined due to a short-lived boycott by advertisers against the increase in prime time advertising rates.
Gonzales added he expected Benpres to achieve its 25 percent earnings growth target this year.
